svg.text: Keyboard-visible recovery — evidence and target contract
Current image is native board capture on older source dcfbdb0b; target preserves its no-extra-button geometry.
400px keyboard/handle shown by command; no touch, typing, or recovery action occurred.
1 · Keep the existing handle as the clear hide route and retain focused-app context.
2 · Keyboard-visible escape/typing behavior requires a real action, not a static mockup.
Do not add a recovery button or infer hidden Home/Back reachability. Verify shown/hidden states,
focus, asymmetric text, reversal and finger access on the integrated candidate.
